query: SELECT u.display_name, AVG(p.score) FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id JOIN votes v ON v.post_id = p.id GROUP BY u.display_name ORDER BY AVG(p.score) DESC

SELECT u.display_name, u.reputation, u.location, COUNT(p.id), AVG(p.score) FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.display_name, u.reputation, u.location ORDER BY u.reputation D
SELECT DISTINCT u.location, p.post_type_id FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id
SELECT u.display_name, MAX(p.view_count) FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id JOIN votes v ON v.post_id = p.id GROUP BY u.display_name ORDER BY MAX(p.view_count) DESC
SELECT u.display_name, MIN(p.score) FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id JOIN votes v ON v.post_id = p.id GROUP BY u.display_name ORDER BY MIN(p.score) DESC
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY creation_date ASC
SELECT DISTINCT u.display_name FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id
SELECT display_name, (SELECT MAX(view_count) FROM posts WHERE owner_user_id = users.id) as max_views FROM users WHERE reputation > 200
